name: Coordinates by Another Name
description: Compose band, block, and count designations to find and sink an unknown fleet. Shots reveal a persistent chart of evidence.
natural_language: Sink every vessel with as few shots as possible. Compose a band, block, and count on the console, then fire. Arrows on block brackets show the count direction. A star count sweeps one entire block run; sweep charges are limited. Vessels are straight and occupy adjacent chart cells. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Programs in an isolated agent sandbox may process screenshots and issue mouse and keyboard actions through the provided gateway. Do not access the task environment through Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, the task terminal or shell, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs. Do not interact with unrelated, blank, settings, or pre-existing non-task tabs. Only tabs opened by visible task controls as part of the task are allowed, using their visible controls only.

metadata.notes: Original irregular symbolic chart. Persistent evidence means temporal memory is not required. Public browser play is inspectable exploration, not secret evaluation.
